title: Wiemer split heading (v2)
description: A heading split into letters that rise 1.2em from under their line and fade in one after another, left to right, as it scrolls into view. Words stay whole, so it wraps like normal text.
notes: CSS scroll-driven (a named view timeline); static HTML, old browsers and reduced motion show the plain heading
screen readers get the whole text through aria-label
set size, weight and colour with className
